project: Wuxia Life P18 Legacy, Disciples, And Heirs Closure
description: Complete late-life wuxia legacy closure by making disciples, heirs, inheritable assets, burdens, and cultivation tradeoffs produce materially different successor-facing outcomes through profile-first configuration, minimal theme-neutral runtime support, representative legacy samples, and evidence-based validation without adding UI work, new themes, or a large runtime rewrite.

userStories.title: Audit successor cultivation surfaces
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only audit of current disciple, offspring, heir, and successor cultivation surfaces so that P18 targets the highest-impact late-life training gaps first.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit the current disciple, offspring, heir, adopted-successor, or inheriting-student cultivation surfaces
Mark each cultivation surface as config-driven, partially config-driven, or runtime-bound
Record where current successor-facing outcomes stop at summary text instead of creating persistent downstream consequence
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Audit inheritable asset and burden surfaces
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only audit of current inheritance surfaces so that P18 can close the biggest gaps in what late-life achievements actually pass on.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit the current inheritance surfaces for martial teachings, technical skills, social capital, wealth or industry, reputation, vendettas, and responsibilities
Mark each inheritance surface as config-driven, partially config-driven, or runtime-bound
Record where major achievements currently end as personal summary only instead of shaping successor-facing outcome space
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Audit late-life legacy divergence gaps
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only inventory of weak legacy divergence points so that P18 implementation can focus on the places where different cultivation choices still collapse into similar endings.
acceptanceCriteria: Record the current late-life points where successor quality, inheritance mix, or cultivation effort should create divergence but currently do not
Identify which low-divergence cases are config-only, content-only, or runtime-bound
Record where burden, instability, or betrayal paths are missing or too weak to matter
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Write successor role rules
userStories.description: As a designer, I want explicit rules for disciples, heirs, children, and adopted successors so that later P18 stories converge on one coherent legacy model.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the shared and distinct roles of disciples, heirs, children, adopted successors, and inheriting students
Define which successor types can overlap on inheritance channels and which should stay partially distinct in the first P18 pass
Record what counts as meaningful successor quality, capacity, loyalty, or instability in P18
Save the rules under docs/designs/ or docs/

userStories.title: Write inheritance scope and burden rules
userStories.description: As a designer, I want explicit inheritance rules so that P18 models both continuity and burden instead of treating legacy as reward-only carryover.
acceptanceCriteria: Define which inheritance channels are in scope for P18 and which are deferred beyond it
Define how positive inheritance and inherited burden should differ across teachings, skills, networks, assets, reputations, vendettas, and responsibilities
Record which inheritance effects should stay explicit in summaries or reports versus which may remain partially implicit in downstream weighting
Save the rules under docs/designs/ or docs/

userStories.title: Write cultivation investment and outcome rules
userStories.description: As a designer, I want explicit cultivation investment rules so that successor building competes with the protagonist's own late-life opportunities and can end in success, mediocrity, rupture, or transcendence.
acceptanceCriteria: Define how cultivation investment trades against the protagonist's own late-life opportunity space
Define the target balance across time, resources, attention, emotional burden, political exposure, and deferred personal progress
Record how success, mediocrity, betrayal, loss, incapacity, or transcendence can appear as legacy outcomes in the first P18 pass
Save the rules under docs/designs/ or docs/
